label: CIS Microsoft Windows 11 Benchmark v3.0.0
coverage_note: Deliberately narrow. CIS Windows Benchmark sub-section numbering has shifted across published revisions (v1.x through v5.x were compared for this mapping), so only the 11 controls below -- each cross-checked against multiple independently published excerpts of the benchmark and found to be stable across versions -- are included. They cover 7 of NetAudit's 43 posture checks: SMB signing, UAC admin approval mode, Windows Firewall state/inbound-block/logging (all three profiles), LLMNR, and IPv6. The remaining 36 checks (SMB1, guest/blank-password/autologon account hygiene, TLS/SCHANNEL protocol and cipher settings, WPAD/NetBIOS/mDNS/DNS-over-HTTPS, remote access services, Wi-Fi, listening services, BitLocker, Defender, Windows Update, broad firewall allow-rules) were deliberately left unmapped rather than assigned a guessed sub-section identifier -- see the package README for the confidence notes behind each entry. 18.6.19.2.1 is a Level 2 (not Level 1) recommendation; NetAudit does not distinguish benchmark levels in its output. This is an indicative technical mapping, not a CIS-certified crosswalk, and covers only the network-facing subset of the benchmark a single host audit can observe.

controls.title: Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)
User Account Control: Run all administrators in Admin Approval Mode
Windows Firewall: Domain: Logging: Log dropped packets
Disable IPv6 (Ensure TCPIP6 Parameter 'DisabledComponents' is set to '0xff (255)')
